name: Golf
pricing: Start with field-strength adjusted strokes-gained projections by surface/course fit; simulate round scores with weather and tee-time effects; normalize outright probabilities to 100% and derive matchup prices from paired simulations.

name: Volleyball
markets: Match winner, set handicap, total points, correct score
pricing: Estimate side-out and break-point rates by rotation from opponent-adjusted recent sets; simulate best-of-five scoring with venue and confirmed lineup adjustments.

name: Rugby Union
pricing: Use opponent-adjusted expected tries and penalty points, home advantage, rest and confirmed XV strength; fit correlated scoring distributions for moneyline, spread and total.

name: Cricket
markets: Match winner, innings total, player performance, outright
pricing: Project runs and wickets by format from venue, toss, weather and confirmed XI; simulate innings ball-by-ball with batter/bowler matchup rates and chase-state effects.

name: Snooker
markets: Match winner, frame handicap, correct score, outright
pricing: Convert opponent-adjusted frame win rates from scoring, break-building and safety indicators; apply a best-of-N binomial structure with deciding-frame sensitivity.

name: Darts
markets: Match winner, handicap, total legs/sets, outright
pricing: Estimate leg hold and break probabilities from three-dart average, first-nine average, doubles and throw order; simulate the exact event format.

name: Baseball
pricing: Build run distributions from confirmed starters, bullpen availability, batting quality, park and weather; use correlated team Poisson/negative-binomial simulations.

name: Gaelic Sports
markets: Gaelic Football and Hurling: match winner, handicap, total points
pricing: Rate goal and point production separately using opponent-adjusted form, venue and confirmed teams; simulate scoring under competition-specific rules.

name: Greyhounds
pricing: Project sectional and finishing times from graded runs, trap, track/distance, going and crowding risk; simulate each runner jointly and normalize win probabilities across the field.

name: Tennis
markets: Match winner, set/game handicap, total games, correct score
pricing: Estimate surface-adjusted serve and return point probabilities with recency and fitness; simulate points, games and sets under the tournament format.

name: Motor Racing
pricing: Combine practice/qualifying pace, degradation, grid position, reliability, strategy and weather; run lap-level simulations with safety-car and retirement states.

name: Handball
pricing: Estimate pace and attack/defence efficiency from opponent-adjusted possessions, goalkeeper rates, venue and lineups; simulate correlated goal totals.

name: Ice Hockey
pricing: Use expected goals, shot quality, special teams, rest and confirmed goaltenders; simulate regulation and overtime separately.

name: Basketball
pricing: Project possessions and lineup-adjusted offensive/defensive efficiency with rest and travel; simulate correlated scores and convert margins to moneyline/spread/total probabilities.

name: Rugby League
pricing: Estimate set efficiency, field position, tries and goal-kicking from opponent-adjusted form, venue and confirmed squads; simulate correlated scores.
